nameOfQualification: Technician - Automation Maintenance for Medical Device Plant
description: Technician- Automation Maintenance for Medical Device Plant facility will be responsible for ensuring the uninterrupted operation of critical medical manufacturing equipment and automation systems. He/She will be involved in conducting routine maintenance, diagnosing, and resolving technical issues, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maintain compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements. He/She has a strong problem-solving skill, attention to detail, and commitment to safety, all of which are pivotal in upholding the reliability and efficiency of our medical device manufacturing processes.
awardingBodyName: Life Sciences Sector Skill Development Council
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, Fresh Skilling, For ToT, For ToA

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Introduction to Life Sciences industry and Job Role , Essential concepts of automation maintenance for medical device plant
Ensure adherence to Environment, health and safety guidelines in automated plant
Prepare for scheduled maintenance as per guidelines.
Plan and Prepare for maintenance using hand tools
Perform machine maintenance and its documentation
Perform Maintenance (Preventive/ breakdown) of automated and robotics machines
Coordinate with reporting manager, teammates, and cross- functional teams

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.EDUCATIONPURSUING: Pursuing 1st Year of Graduation Degree in relevant Field and continuous education
Pursuing 3rd year of 3-year diploma ( after 10th ) approved by AICTE or State Technical Education Regulatory Body in relevant Field and continuous education

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.EDUCATIONCOMPLETED: Completed 2nd year of 2 year diploma (after 12th) approved by AICTE or State Technical Education Regulatory Body in relevant Field
